biggest_catch: The $600 requires holding a $5,000 average daily checking balance for 90 straight days — a large amount of parked cash — plus two $500+ direct deposits.
catches: Paid as a $600 Mastercard Reward Card (usable anywhere Mastercard is accepted), not a cash deposit.
Requires maintaining an average daily checking balance of $5,000 or more during the first 90 days after account opening — significant tied-up funds.
Requires two (2) direct deposits of $500 or more each within the first 90 days after account opening.
Account must remain open and in good standing for 120 days.

A qualifying direct deposit is a regular periodic payment (salary, pension, government payments) via ACH or Real-Time Payment from an employer or outside entity; wire transfers, ACH credits, and transfers initiated from Campus Federal's own website or mobile app do NOT count.
Must register for the offer with code 600FORME at referlive.com/campusfederaloffers and open the Lagniappe Checking account within 30 days of becoming a new member.
New members only; Campus Federal employees, their immediate families, and household members are ineligible.
Lagniappe Checking carries a $10 monthly maintenance fee unless monthly qualifications are met (or a $2,500 average relationship balance is maintained).
Offer can be changed at any time without notice; no fixed expiration date is stated.
Reward card delivery takes 4-6 weeks after all requirements are complete; cards are subject to cardholder terms delivered with the card.
Reward cards may be reported as income to the IRS.

steps: Become a new member of Campus Federal Credit Union (Louisiana; membership subject to approval).
Register for the offer with promo code 600FORME at referlive.com/campusfederaloffers.
Open a new Lagniappe Checking account within 30 days of becoming a member.
Complete two direct deposits of $500 or more each (salary, pension, or government payments via ACH or Real-Time Payment from an outside entity) within the first 90 days after account opening.
Maintain an average daily checking balance of $5,000 or more during the first 90 days after account opening.
Keep the account open and in good standing for 120 days; the $600 Mastercard Reward Card arrives 4-6 weeks after all requirements are complete.
